title: How taxes work
examples: How is income tax calculated on my salary?
What kinds of things do taxes actually pay for?
Is sales tax the same as VAT?

explain.say: Today we learn how taxes help fund our community.

items: Taxes are money paid to the government.
This money pays for public services.
Everyone contributes to keep things running.

explain.say: Income tax is money taken from your wages.
Sales tax is added when you buy goods or services.
These taxes pay for things like roads and schools.
A real-life example is buying a new phone today.
A common mistake is thinking only rich people pay taxes.

faq.q: Do I have to pay taxes even if I don't earn much money?
faq.a: Yes, even on low incomes, you may have to pay some tax. This is because taxes fund essential services for everyone in the community. You might also be taxed on purchases.
asks: What is the minimum tax rate?
Do all income levels pay taxes?

faq.q: Is sales tax the same as VAT?
faq.a: They are related but not exactly the same thing. VAT is a specific type of sales tax applied across many goods and services. Both are taxes added at the point of sale. It is important to know the difference.
asks: What is the difference between sales tax and VAT?
Is VAT just another name for sales tax?

faq.q: What is the main difference between income tax and sales tax?
faq.a: Income tax is taken from your earnings before you spend the money. Sales tax is added to the price tag when you are buying something. One affects your money coming in, the other affects your money going out.
asks: When do you pay sales tax?

faq.q: Does the government use all the tax money for one thing?
faq.a: No, the money is usually divided among many different services. Some goes to health, some to education, and some to maintaining infrastructure like roads. It is a large pool of funds.
asks: What is the tax money spent on?
Are all services funded by taxes?

faq.q: If I buy something online, do I still pay sales tax?
faq.a: Yes, most goods purchased online are still subject to sales tax. The seller must calculate and pass that tax amount to the government. Always check the final price shown.
asks: Does online shopping mean no sales tax?
How is tax calculated for online goods?

facts: Income tax is calculated based on your total taxable earnings.
Sales tax is a percentage added to the cost of goods or services.
Taxes fund public services like police, schools, and roads.
The tax rate can change based on government policy.

quiz.say: If your gross salary is 1000 and your income tax deduction is 150, what is your take-home pay?
quiz.why: You subtract the tax amount from the total salary to find what you keep.

wrong.0: Ignoring the tax deduction means you assume no tax is taken.
wrong.1: This only represents the tax taken, not the final amount.
wrong.3: Adding the tax back suggests it was extra money you earned.

quiz.say: When buying a book for 50 and paying 5 in tax, what is the total cost?
quiz.why: You must add the sales tax amount to the original price of the item.

wrong.0: This ignores the mandatory sales tax added to the purchase.
wrong.1: This only calculates the tax amount, not the total cost.
wrong.3: Dividing the tax by the price suggests a discount was applied.

quiz.say: If a government builds a new hospital, which source of funding is most likely responsible?
quiz.why: Large public infrastructure like hospitals are paid for by general tax revenue.

wrong.1: Sales tax is usually too small to fund massive projects alone.
wrong.2: While income tax is key, other sources might contribute to big builds.
wrong.3: While donations help, taxes are the primary, guaranteed source for major public works.
